definitions.gloss: Tezuka Osamu, manga artist and animator
definitions.explanation: The manga artist and animator who shaped modern Japanese manga and TV anime, creator of {鉄腕|てつわん}アトム (Astro Boy), ブラック・ジャック (Black Jack), and {火|ひ}の{鳥|とり} (Phoenix). He is widely called {漫画|まんが}の{神様|かみさま}, "the god of manga."

examples.japanese: {手塚治虫|てづかおさむ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神様|かみさま}→神様：00161_kamisama⟧だ。
examples.english: Tezuka Osamu is the god of manga.

examples.japanese: {手塚治虫|てづかおさむ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧「{鉄腕|てつわん}アトム」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日本初|にほんはつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{連続|れんぞく}→連続：03783_renzoku⟧テレビアニメだ。
examples.english: Tezuka Osamu's Astro Boy was Japan's first TV anime series.

examples.japanese: {手塚治虫|てづかおさむ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧いて、⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧「ブラック・ジャック」⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{生|い}かした。
examples.english: Tezuka Osamu held a medical license and put that knowledge to use in Black Jack.

notes:
The name is read おさむ even though it is written {治虫|おさむ}: his real name was {手塚治|てづかおさむ}, and he added ⟦{虫|むし}→虫：02262_mushi⟧ (bug) as a boy because he loved the ground beetle, オサムシ.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{漫画|まんが}→漫画：01511_manga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{神様|かみさま}→神様：00161_kamisama⟧: the god of manga
- {手塚|てづか}⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧: Tezuka's works
- {手塚治虫文化賞|てづかおさむぶんかしょう}: the Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize for manga

CULTURAL NOTE:
He introduced film-like panel layouts and long story manga after World War II, and his studio set the low-budget production style of Japanese TV anime. Many later artists, gathered at the Tokiwa-sō apartment house, began as his followers.
